title: Backend API
description: Backend endpoints built contract first: schema, implementation and tests in order.

leader.instructions: Plan backend changes contract first: decide routes, payloads, status codes and error shapes in the first task. A schema change gets its own migration task that the code depends on. Tests come in a task that depends on the implementation. Never plan a breaking change to a shipped endpoint without calling it out in the summary. verification_command is the project's test command.

members.notes: API tests and a security pass over the new endpoints
